info.name: Moxion Power Developer Device Faults Device Location API

params.name: deviceId
params.description: Identifier of the Mobile Power Unit device.

params.name: start
params.description: Inclusive start of the time range (ISO 8601). Range [start, end); max duration 1 day.

params.name: end
params.description: Exclusive end of the time range (ISO 8601). Range [start, end); max duration 1 day.

items.docs: Gets a set of Timestamped Locations for a device. The time range of locations is specified with the start and end parameters, including start and excluding end - [start, end). The max duration cannot exceed 1 day.

params.name: deviceId
params.description: Identifier of the Mobile Power Unit device.

items.docs: Returns the most recent Timestamped Location for the specified device.
